source.page_text:
Figure 4.28: Allegra simulations at 40 ns into the current pulse of Mykonos shot 17133. The
images show the current, magnetic field across the gap, current density in the cathode, and
temperature in the cathode. The lineouts of each of the profiles shown are taken at either
the foil-edge location or the foil-middle location, as represented by Fig. 4.27, right panel.
[Simulation data courtesy of Alex Sarracino, Derek Lamppa, and Kyle Cochrane from Sandia
National Laboratories.]

findings: Both native overlays restrict retained samples to the central shaded rows.

selection.task: Implement and independently verify a separate manufactured single-patch prescribed-power reference with strictly positive activation energy and fixed-reference coverage-dependent kinetics.
selection.rationale: The isolated zero-power reference verifies Arrhenius cooling, while the later prescribed-power reference explicitly rejects nonzero activation energy. Neither verifies temperature-dependent rates coupled to forced heating, power discontinuities and separate gross energy channels.
